saints.name: Cyril of Jerusalem
saints.summary: Cyril of Jerusalem was a prominent bishop and theologian in the early Church, known for his catechetical lectures that laid the groundwork for Christian instruction on the Creed and Sacraments. He faced persecution during his episcopate but remained steadfast in his faith, famously opposing the attempts to rebuild the Jewish temple under Emperor Julian. Cyril's legacy endures through his writings and his role in the defense of orthodoxy against heresy.
